comment: Device budgets from docs/plan.md section 2. Absolute limits apply on the device only; on a simulator the gate fails on a regression larger than simRegressionTolerance against the previous sim row instead.

galleryMs.label: Tabs button to gallery visibly settled (ms)
galleryMs.reason: Ends when the page is within 0.5 pt of its card (TabGalleryTransition), not at Core Animation's settle of the 0.42 s spring (~0.98 s on the Duo). The spring alone takes ~0.6 s to come within 0.5 pt, so 800 leaves ~200 ms for stalls.

swipeMs.label: Bar swipe: finger lift to page settled (ms)
swipeMs.reason: Measured from the finger lifting (tab.swipeSettle), so the scripted drag in the UI test is left out. Ends when the page is within 0.5 pt of the neighbour and moving less than 0.5 pt a frame, then the hand-off (tab.swipeHandoff, ~10 ms): the 0.35 s spring comes to rest in ~0.3 s from the test's release (40% across at 1200 pt/s), not at its 0.001 pt settle (~0.9 s).
